summary: Tampa Padang Airport serves Mamuju, the capital city of West Sulawesi province in Indonesia. The small regional airport provides essential air connectivity to this remote part of Sulawesi island, supporting both tourism to nearby beaches and local government travel. It handles domestic flights primarily connecting Mamuju to other major Indonesian cities.
faqs:
Q: What is the IATA code for Tampa Padang Airport?
A: The IATA code is MJU, and the ICAO code is WAFJ.

Q: Where is the airport located?
A: It is located in Mamuju, the capital of West Sulawesi (Sulawesi Barat) province in Indonesia, near the coast.

Q: What types of flights operate from this airport?
A: The airport primarily serves domestic flights to other Indonesian cities such as Makassar and Jakarta.

Q: Are there international flights from Tampa Padang?
A: No, Tampa Padang Airport is a domestic-only facility with no international routes.
transport_tips: Taxis and ojeks (motorcycle taxis) are the main ways to reach the airport from Mamuju town, with the journey taking around 20-30 minutes depending on traffic. Pre-arranging transport through your hotel is recommended as ride-hailing apps may have limited availability in the region. Shared angkot minibuses also pass near the airport area but are not ideal for travelers with luggage.
local_tip: Bring cash in Indonesian rupiah for taxis and local transport, as card payment facilities are limited. Also note that the airport can be affected by heavy rain and low visibility during the wet season (November to April), so build buffer time into your travel plans.
